ActivateBody.description:
Body of ``POST /{strategy_id}/activate`` (contract ActivateRequest).

``mode`` is accepted as text so AUTO_LIVE gets an explicit
TRADE_MODE_DISABLED explanation instead of a generic schema error.

Attributes:
    version: Version to activate.
    mode: ``ALERT_ONLY``, ``PAPER`` or ``SHADOW``.
    instruments: Optional explicit instruments.
ActivateBody.title: ActivateBody

AllNode.description:
TRUE when every child is TRUE (Kleene conjunction).

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``ALL``.
    id: Stable editor id echoed in the reason tree.
    label: Optional display label.
    children: 1-32 child nodes.
AllNode.title: AllNode

AnyNode.description:
TRUE when any child is TRUE (Kleene disjunction).

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``ANY``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    children: 1-32 child nodes.
AnyNode.title: AnyNode

AoiOverlapNode.description:
Two live AOIs of different kind sets overlap.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``AOI_OVERLAP``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    kinds_a: First kind set.
    kinds_b: Second kind set.
    side: Required side for both AOIs.
    tf: Detection timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    min_overlap_pct: Minimum overlap as percent of the smaller zone.
AoiOverlapNode.title: AoiOverlapNode

AoiTouchNode.description:
A recent closed bar touched a previously confirmed AOI.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``AOI_TOUCH``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    kinds: Acceptable AOI kinds.
    side: Required AOI side.
    tf: AOI detection timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    within_bars: Lookback in closed signal bars (0 = current bar).
    touch: Intersection rule.
    require_active: AOI must still be live at evaluation time.
    min_quality: Minimum plugin quality score.
AoiTouchNode.title: AoiTouchNode

BacktestBody.description:
Body mirroring the contract ``BacktestRequest``.

Unknown fields are rejected (422).

Attributes:
    version: Strategy version number to evaluate.
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    from_ms: Inclusive start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive end, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    fee_bps: Fee per side in basis points; when omitted, the
        strategy's fee estimate or 0.
    slippage_bps: Slippage on market fills in basis points; the
        runner's default when omitted.
    max_hold_bars: Bars before a timeout exit (1..10000); the runner's
        default when omitted.
BacktestBody.title: BacktestBody

CandleOperand.description:
Signal-candle field operand.

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``candle``.
    tf: Candle timeframe (signal timeframe only in this version).
    field: OHLCV field.
    bars_ago: Offset in closed signal bars.
CandleOperand.title: CandleOperand

CompareNode.description:
Binary comparison of two operands.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``COMPARE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    left: Left operand.
    cmp: Comparator.
    right: Right operand.
CompareNode.title: CompareNode

ConstOperand.description:
Constant decimal operand.

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``const``.
    value: The constant.
ConstOperand.title: ConstOperand

CrossesNode.description:
``left`` crossed ``right`` between the previous and current bar.

``ABOVE``: at or below on the previous bar, above on the current one;
``BELOW`` mirrors it.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``CROSSES``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    left: Moving operand.
    right: Reference operand.
    direction: ``ABOVE`` or ``BELOW``.
CrossesNode.title: CrossesNode

DataPolicy.description:
Input freshness policy.

Attributes:
    max_data_age_ms: Maximum time from the evaluated bar's close to the
        evaluation; an older bar evaluates to UNKNOWN.
    allow_rest_poll: Whether polled (POLL) candles are acceptable.
DataPolicy.title: DataPolicy

EventNode.description:
An indicator event confirmed within the lookback.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``EVENT``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    name: Event name.
    source: Plugin that must publish the event; any plugin's events of
        that name count when omitted.
    tf: Event timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    within_bars: Lookback in closed signal bars (0 = current bar).
EventNode.title: EventNode

EventRef.description:
Reference to an indicator event on a timeframe.

Attributes:
    name: Event name.
    source: Plugin that must publish the event; any plugin's events of
        that name count when omitted.
    tf: Event timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
EventRef.title: EventRef

InRangeNode.description:
Operand inside ``[low, high]`` (or open interval when exclusive).

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``IN_RANGE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    value: Tested operand.
    low: Lower bound operand.
    high: Upper bound operand.
    inclusive: Whether bounds are inclusive.
InRangeNode.title: InRangeNode

InZoneNode.description:
Price inside a live AOI of the given kinds on ``tf``.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``IN_ZONE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    kinds: Acceptable AOI kinds.
    side: Required AOI side, if any.
    tf: AOI detection timeframe.
    price_source: Candle price compared with the zone.
    group: Nodes sharing a group must agree on the AOI ``group_id``.
InZoneNode.title: InZoneNode

IndicatorOperand.description:
Published indicator value operand.

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``indicator``.
    plugin_id: Producing plugin.
    tf: Series timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    field: Published value key.
    bars_ago: Offset in closed signal bars.
IndicatorOperand.title: IndicatorOperand

LocalTimeWindow.description:
Local-time window ``[start, end)``; ``end <= start`` wraps midnight.

Attributes:
    start: Inclusive start ``HH:MM``.
    end: Exclusive end ``HH:MM``.
LocalTimeWindow.title: LocalTimeWindow

MarketOperand.description:
Market context operand (funding, open interest, spread, turnover).

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``market``.
    field: Market field.
MarketOperand.title: MarketOperand

NotNode.description:
Kleene negation of one child.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``NOT``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    child: Negated node.
NotNode.title: NotNode

NotificationPolicy.description:
Notification and de-duplication policy.

Attributes:
    cooldown_bars: Bars after a fired entry during which new entries
        on the same instrument/direction are blocked.
    once_per_aoi: Fire at most once per AOI.
    emit: Signal kinds the user wants to receive.
    channels: Notification channels allowed for this strategy.
NotificationPolicy.title: NotificationPolicy

PersistForNode.description:
Child TRUE on each of the last ``bars`` closed bars.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``PERSIST_FOR``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    bars: Number of consecutive bars.
    child: Persisting node.
PersistForNode.title: PersistForNode

RevalidateBody.description:
Optional body of ``POST /{strategy_id}/validate``.

Attributes:
    version: Version to re-validate (latest when omitted).
RevalidateBody.title: RevalidateBody

RiskModel.description:
Stop, target and minimum reward/risk policy.

Attributes:
    min_rr: Strategy-level floor for net reward/risk on every entry.
    stop_model: How the protective stop is placed.
    stop_buffer_atr: Stop buffer in ATR(14) multiples.
    target_model: How the target is placed.
    target_kinds: AOI kinds ``NEAREST_AOI`` may target.
    fixed_r: Reward multiple for ``FIXED_R`` targets.
    fee_bps_estimate: Estimated cost per side in basis points.
    max_risk_pct_equity: Sizing hint for the execution engine.
RiskModel.title: RiskModel

RiskRewardNode.description:
Projected net reward/risk is at least ``min_rr``.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``RISK_REWARD``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    min_rr: Minimum net reward/risk.
RiskRewardNode.title: RiskRewardNode

SequenceNode.description:
Ordered events on distinct bars ending on the evaluated bar.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``SEQUENCE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    within_bars: Window length in bars, including the evaluated bar.
    steps: 2-8 ordered event references.
SequenceNode.title: SequenceNode

SetupPolicy.description:
Setup lifetime policy.

Attributes:
    expire_after_bars: Bars after which an unfired setup expires.
SetupPolicy.title: SetupPolicy

StateNode.description:
Published indicator state on one or more timeframes.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``STATE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    plugin_id: Plugin whose latest warm snapshot is read.
    timeframes: Timeframes checked.
    where: Clauses that must all match on a timeframe.
    match: ``ALL`` or ``K_OF_N``.
    k: Threshold for ``K_OF_N``.
StateNode.title: StateNode

StrategyDefinition.description:
User-authored strategy (Rule AST v2).

Attributes:
    schema_version: Always 2.
    strategy_id: Slug unique per tenant.
    name: Display name.
    description: Optional description.
    direction: ``LONG`` or ``SHORT``.
    signal_timeframe: Timeframe whose closed bars trigger evaluation.
    universe: Instrument universe.
    when: Root rule node.
    risk: Risk model.
    notification: Notification policy.
    setup: Setup policy.
    data_policy: Freshness policy.
    execution_mode: Requested mode (AUTO_LIVE additionally needs an
        execution-engine deployment with consent).
StrategyDefinition.title: StrategyDefinition

TimeWindowNode.description:
Evaluated bar starts inside a local-time window.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``TIME_WINDOW``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    time_zone: IANA time zone of the windows.
    windows: Accepted windows.
    weekdays: Accepted ISO local weekdays (1 = Monday); every day when
        omitted.
TimeWindowNode.title: TimeWindowNode

Universe.description:
Instruments a strategy may evaluate.

Attributes:
    qualification: ``QUALIFIED_ONLY`` or ``ANY``.
    venues: Allowed venues.
    whitelist: If non-empty, only these instruments.
    blacklist: Excluded instruments.
    min_qualified_minutes: Minimum continuous qualification time.
Universe.title: Universe

ValueMatch.description:
One STATE clause: a published value equals one of ``any_of``.

Values compare with the same JSON type, so a string never equals a
boolean.

Attributes:
    field: Published value key.
    any_of: Accepted values.
ValueMatch.title: ValueMatch

WithinBarsNode.description:
Child TRUE on at least one of the last ``bars`` + 1 bars.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``WITHIN_BARS``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    bars: Lookback in bars.
    child: Tested node.
WithinBarsNode.title: WithinBarsNode

info.description: Python-authoritative market data, qualification, indicators, strategies and signals. Contracts: joseph-terminal/packages/contracts/schemas.
info.title: Joseph Market Engine

get.description:
Reports liveness and per-venue feed health.

The status is always ``ok`` with HTTP 200 while the process serves
requests; a degraded venue feed shows only in ``venues``.

Returns:
    Health document: ``status``, ``service``, ``version``,
    ``demo_only`` and ``venues`` (venue id to feed state).

Exposes Prometheus metrics.

Returns:
    Prometheus text exposition document.

Returns the caller's progress without private device data.

Args:
    principal: Authenticated tenant principal.
    delivery_id: Opaque delivery identifier.

Returns:
    Public delivery status and redacted error metadata.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If absent or inaccessible to the caller.

schema.title: Response Get Delivery V1 Alerts Deliveries  Delivery Id  Get

get.description:
Lists the caller's subscriptions.

Args:
    principal: Caller; only their tenant's subscriptions are listed.

Returns:
    Contract ``AlertSubscriptionList``: subscriptions on
    user-managed channels and the channels with server credentials.

schema.title: Response List Subscriptions V1 Alerts Subscriptions Get

delete.description:
Deletes a notification destination owned by the caller.

Args:
    principal: Authenticated tenant principal.
    subscription_id: Public subscription identifier.

Returns:
    Empty HTTP 204 response after deletion.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If the owned destination does not exist.

put.description:
Creates or replaces a subscription.

Args:
    principal: Caller; the subscription belongs to their tenant.
    subscription_id: Identifier from the path.
    body: Contract ``AlertSubscription``.

Returns:
    Stored contract ``AlertSubscription``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If the id or a body field is
        invalid (422).

schema.title: Response Put Subscription V1 Alerts Subscriptions  Subscription Id  Put

post.description:
Queues a notification-only test for an enabled destination.

Args:
    principal: Authenticated tenant principal.
    subscription_id: Public subscription identifier.

Returns:
    Pending delivery metadata for status polling.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If no owned destination exists.
    errors.UnsupportedError: If disabled or not configured.

schema.title: Response Test Subscription V1 Alerts Subscriptions  Subscription Id  Test Post

get.description:
Returns areas of interest (AOIs) and recent events.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    tf: Timeframe value, such as ``1h``.
    plugin_set: Query ``set``: comma-separated plugin ids; all
        plugins compatible with this chart and their default
        settings when absent.
    at_ms: Point in time, UTC epoch milliseconds; the latest closed
        bar when absent.
    settings: JSON object mapping plugin ids to setting overrides.

Returns:
    Contract ``AoiList``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If a parameter or a setting
        override is invalid (422).
    errors.MissingDataError: If no closed candle is available (422).

schema.title: Response Get Aois V1 Aois Get

get.description:
Lists the trading sessions of a calendar in a window.

The window ``[from_ms, to_ms)`` may span at most 400 days. A 24x7
calendar never closes and returns no sessions.

Args:
    calendar_id: Contract ``CalendarId`` (``24x7``, ``XTAI``,
        ``XNYS``, ``USBOND``).
    from_ms: Inclusive window start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive window end, UTC epoch milliseconds.

Returns:
    Contract ``SessionList``.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: For an unknown calendar (404).
    errors.ValidationFailedError: For an empty or too long window
        (422).

schema.title: Response Calendar Sessions V1 Calendars  Calendar Id  Sessions Get

get.description:
Returns historical candles with provenance and gaps.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    tf: Timeframe value, such as ``1h``.
    from_ms: Inclusive start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive end, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    limit: Maximum bars (default 500, max 5000).
    feed_mode: Contract ``FeedMode`` (``AUTO`` when absent);
        ``REPLAY`` reads recordings, the other modes the venue.

Returns:
    Contract ``CandleBatch``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: On an invalid id, timeframe,
        range, limit or ``feed_mode`` (422).
    errors.NotFoundError: If the venue is not enabled (404).
    errors.MissingDataError: For ``REPLAY`` without a replay source
        (422).

Lists usable indicator plugins in registration order.

The built-ins come first, then the plugins of installed plugin
packages; each entry carries the kinds, events and values the
plugin publishes and its display hints.

Returns:
    Contract ``IndicatorPluginList``.

schema.title: Response List Plugins V1 Indicators Plugins Get

get.description:
Returns one plugin's published values on every closed bar.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    tf: Timeframe value, such as ``1h``.
    plugin: Plugin id.
    from_ms: First bar start, UTC epoch milliseconds; the default
        lookback window when absent.
    settings: JSON object mapping plugin ids to setting overrides;
        only the entry for ``plugin`` is used.

Returns:
    Contract ``IndicatorSeries``.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If the plugin id is unknown (404).
    errors.UnsupportedError: If the plugin is disabled or removed
        (422).
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If a parameter or a setting
        override is invalid (422).

schema.title: Response Get Series V1 Indicators Series Get

get.description:
Returns indicator snapshots as of a point in time.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    tf: Timeframe value, such as ``1h``.
    plugin_set: Query ``set``: comma-separated plugin ids; all
        plugins compatible with this chart and their default
        settings when absent.
    at_ms: Point in time, UTC epoch milliseconds; the latest closed
        bar when absent.
    settings: JSON object mapping plugin ids to setting overrides.

Returns:
    Contract ``IndicatorSnapshotList``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If a parameter or a setting
        override is invalid (422).
    errors.MissingDataError: If no closed candle is available (422).

schema.title: Response Get Snapshots V1 Indicators Snapshot Get

get.description:
Searches exact-venue instruments.

Args:
    venue: Optional contract ``Venue`` filter.
    market_type: Optional contract ``MarketType`` filter.
    q: Optional search text.
    limit: Maximum results (1..5000, 422 outside).

Returns:
    Contract ``InstrumentList``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: On an unknown ``venue`` or
        ``market_type`` (422).

schema.title: Response List Instruments V1 Instruments Get

get.description:
Returns an order-book snapshot.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    depth: Levels per side (1..1000, 422 outside).

Returns:
    Contract ``OrderBook``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: On a malformed id (422).
    errors.NotFoundError: If the venue is not enabled (404).

schema.title: Response Orderbook V1 Market Orderbook Get

get.description:
Returns qualification results with every gate's evidence.

Args:
    venue: Optional contract ``Venue`` filter.
    status: Optional qualification status filter.
    refresh: Whether to scan again instead of using records
        cached within the service's time to live.

Returns:
    Contract ``QualificationReport``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: On an unknown ``venue`` or
        ``status`` (422).

schema.title: Response Qualification Report V1 Market Qualification Get

get.description:
Returns the latest market snapshot (cached for one second).

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.

Returns:
    Contract ``MarketSnapshot``, flagged stale when older than the
    service's ``stale_after_ms``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: On a malformed id (422).
    errors.NotFoundError: If the venue is not enabled (404).

schema.title: Response Snapshot V1 Market Snapshot Get

get.description:
Lists the caller's signals, newest first.

Args:
    principal: Caller; only their tenant's signals are listed.
    strategy_id: Strategy filter.
    kind: Comma-separated signal kinds; empty parts are ignored.
    instrument_id: Instrument filter.
    from_ms: Inclusive lower bound on bar close, UTC epoch
        milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive upper bound on bar close, UTC epoch
        milliseconds.
    limit: Maximum rows (1..500, 422 outside).

Returns:
    Contract ``SignalList``; ``next_cursor`` is always ``None``
    because the route does not paginate.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If ``from_ms`` is not before
        ``to_ms`` (422).

schema.title: Response List Signals V1 Signals Get

get.description:
Lists the latest version of each strategy.

Args:
    principal: Caller; only their tenant's strategies are listed.

Returns:
    Contract ``StrategyVersionList``.

schema.title: Response List Strategies V1 Strategies Get

post.description:
Stores a new strategy as version 1 (201).

A semantically invalid definition is still stored, as a DRAFT.

Args:
    definition: Rule AST v2 definition.
    principal: Caller; needs the ``strategy:write`` scope.

Returns:
    Contract ``StrategyVersion``.

Raises:
    errors.ConflictError: If the strategy id already exists (409).
    errors.ForbiddenError: If the caller may not write (403).

schema.title: Response Create Strategy V1 Strategies Post

post.description:
Validates a definition without storing it.

Args:
    definition: Rule AST v2 definition.
    principal: Caller.

Returns:
    Contract ``ValidationResult``; an invalid definition is a 200
    response with ``valid`` false, not an error.

schema.title: Response Validate Definition V1 Strategies Validate Post

get.description:
Lists every version of one strategy.

Args:
    strategy_id: Strategy slug.
    principal: Caller.

Returns:
    Contract ``StrategyVersionList``.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If the caller's tenant has no such
        strategy (404).

schema.title: Response Get Strategy V1 Strategies  Strategy Id  Get

post.description:
Activates a version in ALERT_ONLY, PAPER or SHADOW mode.

Args:
    strategy_id: Strategy slug.
    body: Version, mode and optional instruments.
    principal: Caller; needs the ``strategy:write`` scope.

Returns:
    Contract ``StrategyVersion``.

Raises:
    strategy_errors.TradeModeDisabledError: For ``AUTO_LIVE`` (409
        ``TRADE_MODE_DISABLED``).
    errors.ValidationFailedError: For an unknown mode or instrument,
        or a version invalid against the current catalog (422).
    errors.NotFoundError: If the version does not exist (404).
    errors.ForbiddenError: If the caller may not write (403).

schema.title: Response Activate V1 Strategies  Strategy Id  Activate Post

post.description:
Runs a backtest with the production evaluator.

Args:
    strategy_id: Strategy slug.
    body: Parameters; omitted options take the runner's defaults.
    principal: Caller; only their own versions can be run.

Returns:
    Contract ``BacktestReport``.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If the version is not the caller's (404).
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If the range or the strategy is
        invalid for a backtest (422).

schema.title: Response Run Backtest V1 Strategies  Strategy Id  Backtests Post

post.description:
Pauses the active version.

Args:
    strategy_id: Strategy slug.
    principal: Caller; needs the ``strategy:write`` scope.

Returns:
    Contract ``StrategyVersion``.

Raises:
    errors.ConflictError: If no version is active (409).
    errors.ForbiddenError: If the caller may not write (403).

schema.title: Response Pause V1 Strategies  Strategy Id  Pause Post

post.description:
Re-validates a stored version against the current catalog.

A version that no longer validates becomes UNSUPPORTED and is
deactivated.

Args:
    strategy_id: Strategy slug.
    principal: Caller.
    body: Optional version selector; the latest version when
        omitted.

Returns:
    Contract ``ValidationResult``.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: If the strategy or version does not exist
        (404).

schema.title: Response Revalidate V1 Strategies  Strategy Id  Validate Post

post.description:
Stores a new immutable version (201).

A definition identical to the latest version returns that version
instead of creating a duplicate.

Args:
    strategy_id: Strategy slug.
    definition: Edited definition; its ``strategy_id`` must match
        the path.
    principal: Caller; needs the ``strategy:write`` scope.

Returns:
    Contract ``StrategyVersion``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If the definition's id differs
        from the path (422).
    errors.NotFoundError: If the strategy does not exist (404).
    errors.ForbiddenError: If the caller may not write (403).

schema.title: Response Create Version V1 Strategies  Strategy Id  Versions Post

get.description:
Lists venues with capabilities and live feed health.

Returns:
    Contract ``VenueStatusList``.
